newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian wool indicator rises 3 cents to 716c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australian wool indicator rises 3 cents to 716c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose three cents to 716 cents a kg clean on Thursday at sales in Sydney ahead of a three week break in trading, Wool International said.

Merino fleece was mostly dearer, with 19 micron one percent dearer, 20m 1.5 percent dearer, 21m slightly dearer, 22m unchanged, 23/24/26m 0.5 percent dearer and 25m slightly cheaper while merino skirtings were fully firm.
In crossbreds, 27m was 0.5 percent cheaper, 28/29m unchanged, 30m 1.5 percent cheaper and 31m up to one percent dearer.
In cardings, locks were down one percent and crutchings down 1.5 percent.
WI said trading saw good general competition.
Of the 16,912 bales offered in Sydney, 9.8 percent were passed in.
In early Fremantle trading, merino fleece was fully firm with merino skirtings two percent dearer. The offering was 17,282 bales and the early pass-in rate 5.5 percent.
Sales continue in the week beginning July 28 in Sydney and Fremantle with about 79,400 bales to be offered.
